notes: ACS multi-agent-hotload adopter state. Live join/continue order wins; the seed list is a hint only. FULL PCM (4e23854, CLI 0.6.0) + FULL CGM 0.5.12 (6831f91e, eight modules) + OIO 0.1.0 are pinned. Boss lease is minutes (default 30, range 15-120); the watchdog is agent-less and liveness-only. The decision-boss seat is vacant until the first live continuer claims it.

role_fill.notes: First live continuer with a valid lease is decision boss; later continuers fill coder or worker seats. Tool identity does not assign roles.

agents.notes: Seed hint for an empty room; live join/continue order wins when filling vacant seats.

watchdog.notes: AGENT-LESS. Cron/Action/script only. No LLM. No peer agent. Watchdog != failover. ~10m liveness/nudge only.

pcm.notes: Full PCM for adopters. Continuity/checkpoints yes; still NOT the proposal/ACCEPT layer (that stays GitHub + PROPOSALS.md). Pin commit SHA; do not silently follow moving main.

routing.readme_product_entry: writing-direction (MUST load; scan-first selective bold; do not apply HSW bold restraints)
routing.pr_issue_docs_commits: human-sounding-writing / hsw (MUST load for PR/issue titles+bodies, docs, commits)
routing.html_reports_compare_appendable: human-sounding-writing / hsw (MUST; default ON; no per-report opt-in)
routing.contract: docs/writing-routing.json + docs/ACS_VERIFY.md; application=must_load; acs_prompt_inject after VALID

cgm.notes: FULL CGM 0.5.12 required for ACS and all hotloader adopters. Eight modules including human-output-naming. Not HSW+writing-direction only. Validate with scripts/validate_content_system.py (full adapter); then apply acs_prompt_inject.

ticket_links.notes: Parent/child notes only; no full DAG engine.
